purpose: Quantify bias-density degeneracy and count-channel identifiability using completed Z7 synthetic posterior chains before any actual CF4 inference or grid increase.
goal: Protect the CF4-informed z=0 posterior route: identify what the count likelihood constrains, which density modes remain prior-dominated, and whether tracer bias is separately identified.

inputs.read_contract: existing chain and posterior_fields artifacts only; no observed CF4 count or velocity datum

measurements: bias posterior width and cross-chain consistency
posterior physical-density variance reduction by k shell from saved chains
count-only versus velocity-only structure and heldout scores
mode-wise count information proxy relative to prior
interpretation: This is an identifiability audit, not a new posterior or calibration. Correlation is not causation; finite thinned MCMC samples are correlated. No A(k) fit, cutoff selection or power rescaling.
